document.title: Move developer docs out of the README
document.summary: The README now has only install, use, why, and a CLI table. The develop, serve and export, refresh, release, and fixture notes move to a new `CONTRIBUTING.md`. `AGENTS.md` points release work at the new file. All moved text is rewritten in plain words.
document.why: npm shows the README on the package page. It had development, release, and Pages hosting notes that package users do not need.
lookFor: The README no longer says how `refresh` matches hunks. That text is now in `CONTRIBUTING.md` only.
The Develop notes drop the old `npx comprehende@0.8.0` example and keep only the `node dist/cli/main.js` way to run a checkout on another repo.

groups.title: User-facing README
groups.why: This is the text npm users read. It must say what the tool does, how to install it, and how to start a review.
groups.summary: Short intro, install with the Node.js 24+ and git requirement, a Use section that says to run `/comprehende`, a shorter Why, and a table of CLI commands.
lookFor: Check each row of the CLI table against the real flags. The `review` row says the base defaults to `origin/HEAD`, then `main` or `master`.

groups.title: Developer notes in CONTRIBUTING.md
groups.why: The developer notes removed from the README need a home in the repo.
groups.summary: Develop, Serve and export, Refresh, Release, and Fixture sections. The content matches the old README sections, with refresh rules as a list and Pages setup as one path.

groups.title: Agent instructions point to CONTRIBUTING.md
groups.why: `AGENTS.md` sent agents to the README for release steps, which are no longer there.
groups.summary: The Release link now targets `CONTRIBUTING.md`. The Documentation rule says npm shows the README, and that development, release, and internal notes go in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

commits.subject: Move developer docs out of the README
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The README is the npm package page. Keep install, use, why, and the CLI
there; move develop, release, refresh internals, Pages, and fixture
notes to CONTRIBUTING.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
